action_items.description: feat-shareable-stripe-payment-link-admin: Retry with narrow scope. Admin API endpoint POST /api/admin/stripe-link?agentId=X returns a pre-filled Stripe Checkout URL for that agent. Use Stripe Checkout Sessions API (mode=payment or subscription). No UI needed — JSON response. Stojan calls this endpoint, sends link directly via SMS/email to pilot agents.
action_items.reason: Day 90 in 7 days, 0 paying customers. This is the single fastest path to $49 — Stojan sends a link, pilot clicks, pays. Previous dev task failed; retry with explicit minimal scope.

action_items.description: feat-admin-force-trial-activation: Retry with narrow scope. Admin API endpoint POST /api/admin/activate?agentId=X manually sets agent status to trial_active, bypassing email verification. Returns success + agent email. Stojan calls this when a pilot is stuck. No UI, JSON only.
action_items.reason: 35 pilot signups potentially stuck at email verification. Each stuck agent is a lost conversion. Narrow the scope — one endpoint, one action, done.

action_items.description: feat-lapsed-trial-reactivation: Retry with narrow scope. Script (not endpoint) that queries agents with status=trial_expired or created >14d ago with no activity, then sends them a Twilio SMS: 'Hey [name], your LeadFlow trial is waiting — reply YES to reactivate or visit [link]'. One-time trigger via Stojan running node scripts/reactivate-lapsed.js. No cron, no UI.
action_items.reason: 35 pilot signups. Even 10% reactivation = 3-4 conversations. SMS bypasses email deliverability issues. Previous dev tasks all cancelled — simpler script approach avoids cron complexity.

action_items.description: feat-landing-page-pre-signup-capture: Retry with minimal scope. Add email capture field to landing page (product/lead-response/dashboard) with submit handler that POSTs to /api/waitlist (creates row in pilot_signups with source=landing_organic). Show 'We'll reach out soon' confirmation. No magic link, no Stripe, no onboarding flow.
action_items.reason: Landing page sends traffic away. Even basic capture of interested visitors gives Stojan a list to personally follow up. Keep it simple to avoid dev agent failure.

action_items.description: fix-signup-activated-rate-metric-collection: Retry. Query: SELECT COUNT(*) as signups, COUNT(CASE WHEN status IN ('trial_active','paid') THEN 1 END) as activated FROM real_estate_agents WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'. Write result to metrics table (domain='funnel', metric_type='signup_to_activated_rate'). One script, runs on cron. No new tables.
action_items.reason: Top metric gap per mission. Without this metric we're blind on the most critical funnel step.

action_items.description: Add to dev RULES.md: Before implementing a feature, run 'git log --oneline --all | grep <uc-id-keyword>' to check if the same work exists on a recent branch. If the feature is already merged into main, verify it works (run the relevant test or grep for the function) and report success without re-implementing. Also: when a task description says 'retry', search completion-reports/ for the UC ID to understand what previous attempts tried and why they failed — then take a different approach.
action_items.reason: 33 dev failures this week. Pattern 'pre-spawn dedup: identical task completed recently' means dev tasks complete but UCs don't sweep to done, causing re-spawn loops. Dev agents need to detect and report on already-done work rather than re-implementing.

action_items.description: Add to QC RULES.md: Before reviewing a PR, check its current state: run 'gh pr view <PR#> --json state,mergeable,reviews'. If state is MERGED, mark the QC task done immediately — the code is already in main. If state is CLOSED, report the closure reason and mark done. Only perform full review for OPEN PRs with no prior approved code_review entry in the DB.
action_items.reason: 13 QC failures including 'pre-spawn dedup: identical task completed recently'. QC agents are re-reviewing already-merged PRs. Need explicit check for PR state before starting review.

action_items.description: Add to PM RULES.md: Before starting a UC analysis, search completion-reports/ for your UC ID: `ls /Users/clawdbot/projects/leadflow/completion-reports/ | grep <uc-id>`. If a COMPLETION report for this UC already exists and was successful, check if anything material changed (git log since that date) — if not, reference the prior analysis and mark done without repeating the work.
action_items.reason: 4 PM failures including 'pre-spawn dedup: identical task completed recently'. PM agents redoing already-completed product analysis wastes budget.
